description: Processing-time estimate for one programme (by id) or all programmes: the typical government processing range, the basis of the estimate and its source. Use when the user asks how long an application takes. Figures are indicative and vary with the case and the workload of the authority.

id.description: Programme id as returned by list_programmes (e.g. "dominica-cbi", "greece-gv") or an unambiguous name ("Dominica", "Portugal golden visa"); an ambiguous name returns the candidates.

name: get_processing_times

outputSchema.description: Mirabello envelope; tool fields vary; error only on failure.
